# Env-gated rigs that CI deliberately does NOT run, each with the reason.
#
# Read by scripts/rigcensus (make check). Anything gated and NOT listed here
# fails the build, so this file is the complete record of what CI does not
# cover and why. Format: ENV_VAR  # reason
#
# An exemption is a DECISION. If you are adding a line here because wiring the
# rig is awkward, wire the rig.

# ── ITEM 3 (ini-0lko): THE CREDENTIAL DECISION — DROPPED, NOT PROVISIONED ───
#
# These rigs spawn a real, authenticated `claude` and cannot run on a runner.
# The bead offered two options: provision a credential in CI, or drop them from
# the gate. DROPPED, and the reasoning is on the bead — in short: provisioning
# puts a live account token in CI secrets and bills real sessions on every push
# to prove things about a THIRD-PARTY TUI that changes without our involvement.
# ini-d7a7 is the evidence: a Claude release moved and our probe reported the
# emitter dead when it was healthy. A gate that red-flags on someone else's
# release schedule trains people to ignore it.
#
# WHAT THE OPERATOR GETS INSTEAD, so this is a trade and not a hole: these stay
# human-run diagnostics, run when bumping Claude. The gate no longer CLAIMS
# them, which is the thing the ruling forbade — a check a human runs by hand
# must not be counted by a machine.
INITECH_6M4         # spawns 8 real Claude sessions; two-window modal parity. Human-run on a Claude bump.
INITECH_ZJHG        # real-Claude dialog measurement (composer echo, click-answers-dialog). Human-run.
INITECH_OSC_PROBE   # real-Claude OSC 777 tripwire. Human-run on a Claude bump; see ini-d7a7.
INITECH_D7A7        # real-Claude OSC emitter diagnostic; answers "what changed" on a bump.
INITECH_ALTPROBE    # real-Claude alt-screen probe.
INITECH_ALTPROBE_VIM # real-vim alt-screen control for the above.
INITECH_LIVEPROBE   # real-Claude live-region probe; needs a specific value (=askq), not just 1.
INITECH_NOTIF_PROBE # real-Claude notification-channel probe.

# ── NOT RIGS AT ALL: helper subprocesses ───────────────────────────────────
#
# These have a gate's exact SHAPE — Getenv then t.Skip — because a test that
# re-execs itself as a child skips in the parent. rigcensus cannot tell them
# from a rig by inspection, and deliberately does not try: a heuristic that
# guessed would fail silently the first time someone wrote a gate it did not
# expect. A human says which it is, here.
INITECH_FOLDBACK_HELPER  # child process of TestFoldback_CrashFoldsAgentIntoWindowOne; runs as its subprocess.
INITECH_LIVENESS_HELPER  # child process of TestChildProcessAlive_*; never run directly.
INITECH_FOLDBACK_ADDR    # address handed to the foldback helper child; not a gate of its own.
